title: Automate Trading Help?
author: Tee_Wil_Trades
selftext:
Hey, has anyone successfully created an automated trading system yet? I have created a series of automated TV alerts to my discord, and I’m trying to figure out how to automate entering trades based off these alerts. 

My system is simple and I do this manually, so I want to automate it so I don’t screw my entries up due to user error etc. 

How I currently have it set up: get alert 1 in discord channel, wait for alert 2. If alert 2 is within 30min of alert 1, market enter on bar close. Target 1:1 risk/reward with stops at most recent swing. 

Anyone have an app/experience in this so that I can create it? Thanks

comments.author: oobface
comments.body: i have a tv alert that enters on signal, it sends a webhook to pickmytrade, u can use any middleman a bunch exist, they will wrap ur trade details in a json that u pre fill out and they send it to your broker ez

replies.author: Tee_Wil_Trades
replies.body: Gotcha thanks, is this for futures or forex that you have it set for?

comments.author: tumbleweedrunner2
comments.body: Hi Tee\_Will\_Trades - we are in early access for building the execution layer and focused on flexible trade management for this type of automation (from webhooks from TV to NinjaTrader now, and Tradovate or Rithmic (coming soon).  We specialize in Futures in particular and the naunces with dealing with front month contracts (derived from continuous contracts that come from TV. ie: something like ES1! resolving properly to the current front month in NT or Tradovate).  It's called sharksignals.com.
